formal_statement: ∀ (d r n : ℕ) (G : MvPolynomial (Fin d) ℂ), 2 ≤ d → 2 ≤ r → G.IsHomogeneous r → (∀ x : Fin d → ℂ, (∀ i, MvPolynomial.eval x (MvPolynomial.pderiv i G) = 0) → x = 0) → PEqualNP.Gct.HasBorderDetExpression G n → (r - 1) * (d - 1) ≤ 11 * n
plain_statement: Chain link 3, NOT routine (its Theorem 2.3, 4e rounded up to 11): a complex form of degree r in d variables whose partials vanish together only at the origin needs border determinantal size at least (r-1)(d-1)/(4e). Method: r(r-1)^(d-2) simple polar points persist under perturbation and are bounded for a determinant by a multihomogeneous Bezout number. Source: the unrefereed manuscript of 24 September 2026 on a cubic lower bound for border dc of the permanent (cited by arXiv:2610.40484); read once by a leg, not verified here.
title: A smooth form of degree r in d variables has border determinantal complexity at least (r-1)(d-1)/11
